# proxmox_node_report (Data Source)

Reads the node diagnostic report from `/nodes/{node}/report`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_report" "r" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `report` (String)
